description.zh: 空间内设备/流状态更新时的回调。
description.en: Callback URL for device or stream status updates in the group.
Indicates whether the space is enabled.

description.zh:
空间使用的接入协议。取值：
- gb28181
- rtmp
description.en:
Ingest protocol used by the group. Valid values:

- gb28181

- rtmp

description.zh:
是否启用按需拉流。取值：
- false（默认）
- true
description.en:
Whether on-demand stream pulling is enabled. Valid values:

- false (default)

- true

description.zh:
空间使用的播放协议，多值用逗号分隔。取值：
- flv
- hls
- rtmp
description.en:
Playback protocols used by the group. Separate multiple values with commas. Valid values:

- flv

- hls

- rtmp
Streaming domain used by the group.

description.zh: 空间使用的推流域名。（仅限于rtmp接入的空间）
description.en: Ingest domain used by the group. Applies only to groups that use the RTMP ingest protocol.

description.zh: 空间所属区域，即服务中心。
description.en: The region where the space is located. This region serves as the service center.
